content: There has been little work on Estonian and Latvian GEC, all limited with rule-based approaches BIBREF30 , BIBREF31 . For both languages, as well as any low-resourced languages, our approach gives a feasible way to do grammatical error correction without needing neither parallel nor error tagged corpora. Style transfer: Several approaches use directly annotated data: for example, BIBREF7 and BIBREF8 train MT systems on the corpus of modern English Shakespeare to original Shakespeare. BIBREF32 collect a dataset of 110K informal/formal sentence pairs and train rule-based, phrase-based, and neural MT systems using this data.
